## Outcome and scope

- Task / packet:
- Source FR/D/AC/G/F IDs and owning contracts:
- Authorization, touched boundaries and explicit exclusions:
- Proposed versus implemented API / migration impact:

## Verification actually performed

List exact commands/environment/results and sanitized evidence. Label mocks,
synthetic data and missing checks; do not leave checked boxes as proof.

## Review

- [ ] Owning docs, acceptance and traceability match this change.
- [ ] Meaningful invalid/empty/stale/race/controlled/focus risks considered.
- [ ] No private data, .repo code/dependencies, unlicensed assets or unrelated changes.
- [ ] Package/headless/server-safe/optional boundaries checked if affected.
- [ ] No unsupported compatibility/WCAG/performance/live-integration claims.
- [ ] TASKS has reviewer disposition, remaining gates and resumable handoff.

## Remaining limits and next action

Merge, publication, deployment and real-consumer changes require their own authority.
